tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the shop's herbal remedies and natural cosmetics. Matches English and Hebrew product names and descriptions; an empty query lists everything. Prices are integer agorot (ILS minor units).

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Look up products or variants by id (product slug or slug@ml).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full detail for one product: description, uses, variants and prices.

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: About the store: who runs it, delivery options and prices, policies (shipping, returns, privacy, terms) and how ordering works.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a priced checkout (cart) for the buyer. Returns totals, delivery options and a continue_url. The buyer must open continue_url to review and pay on the website; this API never takes payment.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Change a checkout: replace line_items, set buyer, apply a coupon code (discounts.codes) or choose a delivery option. Fields you omit stay as they are.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: The store does not complete orders through the API: this returns the checkout with status requires_escalation and the continue_url the buyer uses to pay.
